answer.worked:
Construct a line through the bend parallel to the two horizontal lines. The shallow segment slopes below this line by $\alpha-\beta$ (alternate angles on parallel lines). The angle between the up-left arm and the rightward constructed line is $180^\circ-\gamma$ (co-interior angles on parallel lines).
$$\begin{align*}x&=(180^\circ-\gamma)+(\alpha-\beta)\\x&=180^\circ-\gamma+\alpha-\beta\end{align*}$$
